title: Prevent green-and-stop swarm collapse
objective: Harden the worker protocol after the real 25-worker stress test exposed that zero ready slots caused nearly every Sol to stop after reporting healthy main instead of finding useful support/backfill work.
acceptance: green main alone can never be treated as work completion
workers must exhaust ready, review, stale-recovery, backfill, and capacity-mining roles before stopping
blocked scarce resources redirect capacity to source-only depth rather than speculative retries
no new major feature is unlocked
another 25-worker burst has at least 25 meaningful claimable roles while Hero Gate is externally blocked
notes: Completed by PR #269, merged as 5ee9091eb9d7af665a990381b0133d8ccedea503 after hardened Swarm ownership/resource/digest enforcement and canonical CI both passed. Live board had 35 alternate ready roles while this repair claim was active.
